Rajkot is the heart of Gujarat’s casting, foundry, and machine-tool industry, with dense manufacturing clusters across Aji GIDC, Metoda, and the Shapar-Veraval belt. These engineering sites need tough site offices, security cabins, and supervisor rooms that hold up in heat and dust. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Rajkot in 3 to 5 days. For Rajkot’s hot, dusty, semi-arid conditions we build with durable coatings and proper ventilation. For a porta cabin in Rajkot, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

Compact porta cabins for gate security and supervisor rooms at Rajkot’s Aji, Metoda, and Shapar GIDC zones.

Why Rajkot Buyers Choose SAMAN

The porta cabins a Rajkot buyer finds listed online are mostly IndiaMART and TradeIndia directories — supplier cards thin on real detail. For Rajkot’s foundry and engineering sites, where a cabin sits in a hot, dusty, heavy-duty environment, build quality decides how long it lasts.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. Call us and you reach the team that builds the cabin. Every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated — durable finish for Rajkot’s dust and heat
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panels with factory-sealed joints and sealed doors/windows to keep dust out
  • Colour-coated GI roof with internal false ceiling and ventilation options
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Rajkot: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer’s cost.

Rajkot’s Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Rajkot’s engineering economy creates steady, recurring porta cabin demand across its industrial clusters:

Aji GIDC (PIN 360003): One of Rajkot’s core industrial estates — casting, forging, machine tools, and auto-parts manufacturing. Security cabins at plant gate entries and portable supervisor offices are the most common requirement. The foundry environment values a robust, sealed cabin that keeps dust and heat out.

Anchor-bolted RCC plinth mounting — standard for SAMAN porta cabin deliveries to Rajkot foundry and engineering sites.

Metoda / Lodhika GIDC (PIN 360021): A large GIDC zone south of the city — engineering, diesel engines, submersible pumps, and bearings. Plant gate security cabins, portable QC rooms, and tool stores are typical formats. The scale of Metoda means orders often run to several cabins.

Shapar-Veraval industrial area (PIN 360024): A fast-growing engineering and manufacturing belt on the Rajkot-Gondal highway. Greenfield plant construction here generates multi-room contractor offices and labour accommodation demand.

Construction and infrastructure: Residential development, the Rajkot Smart City works, and the new greenfield Rajkot international airport area generate contractor-office and site-management cabin demand.

We dispatch from Greater Noida via the NH-48 Delhi-Mumbai corridor and the Gujarat highway network — bringing cabins to Rajkot in 3–5 days.

Porta Cabin Specifications — Built for Rajkot’s Heat and Dust

Rajkot’s semi-arid climate brings high summer heat, dry dusty winds, and a short monsoon. Every cabin is specified for these conditions.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth. The powder-coat finish resists the dry abrasive dust common in Rajkot’s industrial areas.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard for thermal insulation against the heat. Cement-board panels available for longer-term outdoor use.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with internal false ceiling — important for managing Rajkot’s summer heat. Turbo ventilators recommended for open foundry and engineering sites.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate. Chequered plate is preferred in dusty industrial settings — easier to clean.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, with sealed louvre or sliding windows to keep dust out. Fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Rajkot

  • Plant gate security cabins at Aji, Metoda, and Shapar GIDC entries
  • Portable supervisor offices and QC rooms at foundry and machine-tool units
  • Multi-room contractor offices at Shapar-Veraval greenfield construction
  • Site offices at Rajkot Smart City and airport-area construction projects
  • Tool and equipment stores at engineering and casting units
  • Labour accommodation blocks at large infrastructure project sites

Porta cabin site offices for Rajkot Smart City and airport-area construction projects.

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • RAL colour choice — light colours recommended for Rajkot’s sun
  • Sealed windows and doors for dust-heavy foundry environments
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for heat management
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage.

How to Order a Porta Cabin in Rajkot

Ordering from SAMAN is a direct, four-step process:

  1. Share your requirement. Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry. Tell us the size, the use (plant gate security, supervisor office, QC room), the site (Aji, Metoda, or Shapar-Veraval GIDC), and any heat-or-dust sealing you need for a foundry environment.
  2. Get a specification and quotation. We confirm the right build — sealed windows and doors for dusty foundry sites, ventilation, and electrical layout — and give you a firm price and production timeline.
  3. Production and dispatch. After you confirm, we manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch via the NH-48 corridor and Gujarat highway network. Transit to Rajkot is 3–5 days.
  4. Site placement. The cabin is set on your RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, and the pre-wired board connected on arrival. A single-room cabin is ready within hours.

Porta Cabin Price in Rajkot — Cost Factors

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF (standard) vs cement-board.
  3. Heat-and-dust additions — sealed windows, turbo ventilator, AC provision per your site.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Rajkot for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Rajkot

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via the NH-48 corridor and the Gujarat highway network on flatbed trucks. Transit: 3–5 days. We handle factory dispatch from North India to Rajkot and across Gujarat — including our porta cabin in Ahmedabad and porta cabin in Vadodara customers. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins. We have no Rajkot warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Rajkot

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Aji, Metoda, and Shapar GIDC?

Yes. We deliver across Rajkot’s industrial zones — Aji GIDC, Metoda/Lodhika GIDC, and Shapar-Veraval — and to construction sites across the Rajkot region. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

How does a porta cabin handle Rajkot’s heat and dust?

The 50 mm PUF panels insulate against the heat, and we fit sealed louvre or sliding windows and doors to keep dust out — important in foundry and engineering environments. The powder-coat frame finish resists Rajkot’s dry abrasive dust. We recommend a turbo ventilator and false ceiling, and an AC provision for any working office used through summer.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Rajkot?

Price depends on size, panel type, fit-out level, and heat-and-dust additions such as sealed windows and ventilation. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a foundry or engineering site in Rajkot?

Yes. We build robust, sealed cabins suitable for plant gate security, supervisor offices, and QC rooms at Rajkot’s casting, forging, and machine-tool units. Dust-sealing, durable coatings, and electrical provisions are confirmed at order stage to suit your site’s conditions.

How long does delivery from the factory to Rajkot take?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the NH-48 corridor, after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry. Standard sizes move faster.

Get a Porta Cabin Quote for Rajkot

For a porta cabin in Rajkot delivered to your GIDC plot, foundry, or construction site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with the right specification for Rajkot’s heat-and-dust conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation.
